label: Shop replica
desc: A replica of a trend shop's production signal set: moving-average crossovers from 8/32 to 64/256 on vol-scaled returns.
rule: EWMA crossovers 8/32, 16/64, 32/128, 64/256 · cap ±2 · equal weight · 10% target
config:
trend_shop_replica:
  asset_classes:
  - crypto
  - futures
  - fx
  universe_filters:
  - type: ListingFilter
  - type: DataIntegrityFilter
  - type: AdvFilter
    params:
      min_adv: 50000000
      lookback: 63
  vol_estimator:
    type: EWMA2
    params:
      hl_1: 5
      hl_2: 10
  vol_normalizer:
    type: Standard
    params:
      target_vol: 0.1
      vol_floor: 0.05
  signal_defaults:
    vol_estimator:
      type: EWMA2
      params:
        span: 32
    capper:
      type: SymmetricCap
      params:
        lower: -2
        upper: 2
    position_function:
      type: CappedLinear
      params:
        scalar: 1
        cap: 2
  signals:
  - type: TimeSeriesSignal
    params:
      indicator:
        type: EWMACrossover
        params:
          fast: 8
          slow: 32
    weight: 0.25
  - type: TimeSeriesSignal
    params:
      indicator:
        type: EWMACrossover
        params:
          fast: 16
          slow: 64
    weight: 0.25
  - type: TimeSeriesSignal
    params:
      indicator:
        type: EWMACrossover
        params:
          fast: 32
          slow: 128
    weight: 0.25
  - type: TimeSeriesSignal
    params:
      indicator:
        type: EWMACrossover
        params:
          fast: 64
          slow: 256
    weight: 0.25
  forecast_div_multiplier:
    type: EstimatedIDM
    params:
      corr_lookback: 252
      cap: 2.5
  asset_allocator:
    type: EqualWeight
    params: {}
  model_gearing:
    type: Forward
    params:
      target_vol: 0.1
      corr_lookback: 126
      leverage_cap: 5.0
  cost_model:
    type: FixedBPS
    params:
      cost_bps: 2.0
